title: Million Mile Tundra Event (A Toyota Tundra with 1 million miles!)
description:
Million Mile Toyota Tundra Event (Greg LeBlanc Toyota)

A Toyota Tundra with a million miles!

On May 11, 2016, Vic Sheppard traded in his 2007 Toyota Tundra and received a brand new 2016 Tundra! The event was a huge success at the dealership; incredible turnout. Here, Vic explains what it was like to see his truck hit 1 million miles. Also, Toyota Tundra chief engineer Mike Sweers explains how he will use Vic's truck to improve future Toyota vehicles.
